hero.headline: Intellectual rigor. Autonomous impact. At the forefront of Middle East tax transformation.
hero.description: We are assembling the premier tax advisory team in the Middle East. If you possess deep technical scholarship, commercial audacity, and a passion for solving intricate fiscal challenges, explore your career with Taxmetryx.

culturePillars.title: Unrivaled Technical Depth
culturePillars.description: We do not compromise on technical precision. Our professionals dive deep into statutory phrasing, OECD commentaries, and economic benchmarking to produce opinions that set the industry standard.

culturePillars.title: Direct Commercial Autonomy
culturePillars.description: You will work directly with founders, board directors, and C-suite decision-makers on marquee transactions, without the bureaucratic layers of traditional conglomerates.

culturePillars.title: Global Exposure from DIFC
culturePillars.description: Based in the heart of Dubai International Financial Centre, your mandates will span cross-border investment routes across the GCC, Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

benefits: Highly competitive tax-free remuneration packages with substantial performance bonus pool
Comprehensive international private medical insurance (including dental & optical)
Annual business-class flight allowance to home country
Sponsored professional qualifications (ADIT, CTA, CIOT, CPA)
Modern, high-spec collaborative workspace in DIFC with flexible hybrid working policies
Continuous executive education with leading international tax professors and economists

openings.title: Director - Transfer Pricing & Financial Transactions
openings.overview: Lead complex transfer pricing engagements, financial transaction modeling, APA negotiations, and head our quantitative benchmarking practice.
responsibilities: Lead high-value economic benchmarking studies and Master/Local File preparation for multi-billion dirham MNEs
Direct synthetic credit rating assessments and intercompany financial transaction pricing models
Manage bilateral Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) negotiations with the Federal Tax Authority
Mentor and supervise a dedicated team of transfer pricing economists and managers
requirements: 10+ years specialized experience within Big-4 or tier-1 tax practice
Master's degree in Economics, Tax Law, or equivalent professional certification (ADIT / CTA)
Demonstrated track record defending transfer pricing audits before tax authorities in the GCC, UK, or Europe
Fluency in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage

openings.title: Senior Manager - UAE Corporate Tax & Restructuring
openings.overview: Provide advisory on UAE Corporate Tax Law No. 47, Free Zone QFZP eligibility, Tax Grouping, and M&A corporate restructurings under Articles 27 and 28.
responsibilities: Deliver comprehensive corporate tax impact assessments and technical position papers for large regional conglomerates
Audit Free Zone business models to determine Qualifying Free Zone Person (QFZP) qualification and de minimis compliance
Advise on corporate reorganization relief, business transfers, and post-merger integration
Review statutory corporate tax return filings and represent clients during FTA clarification requests
requirements: 7+ years corporate tax advisory experience with strong knowledge of UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 47 of 2022
ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent professional qualification
Proven ability to manage client relationships and deliver board-level presentations
Strong analytical and technical writing skills

openings.title: Manager - International Tax & Pillar Two
openings.overview: Drive Pillar Two GloBE 15% modeling, double tax treaty optimization, and cross-border permanent establishment reviews.
responsibilities: Execute GloBE ETR calculations and Transitional CbCR Safe Harbor assessments for multinational groups
Interpret bilateral Double Tax Treaties (DTAAs) and evaluate Principal Purpose Test (PPT) compliance
Perform permanent establishment risk diagnostics for remote workforce and agency models
Draft technical opinions on cross-border withholding tax optimization and foreign tax credit mechanics
requirements: 5+ years specialized international tax experience in cross-border structuring
Deep familiarity with OECD GloBE Model Rules, Model Tax Convention, and BEPS Action Plans

openings.title: Associate - Tax Controversy & Dispute Resolution
openings.overview: Support FTA audit defense, prepare statutory Reconsideration Requests, and assist with Tax Disputes Resolution Committee (TDRC) memorial drafting.
responsibilities: Conduct forensic reviews of accounting records, tax invoices, and contracts during FTA audit proceedings
Draft factual exhibits and legal research memos for Reconsideration applications under the Tax Procedures Law
Track statutory filing deadlines and coordinate administrative documentation with the FTA e-services portal
Prepare penalty waiver submissions under Cabinet Decision No. 49 of 2021
requirements: 2-4 years tax or legal dispute experience within the UAE or GCC
Law degree (LLB) or Accounting / Finance degree with formal tax training
Thorough understanding of the UAE Federal Tax Procedures Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 28 of 2022)
Bilingual English and Arabic is highly advantageous
